note: agent-command v2 and blueprint v2 (hwpx-automation 8.0): text is added, removed, moved and copied as a character range (kind text, <paragraph>/text[s:e]), objects and notes sit at a character offset (position.mode offset), results carry place, and the v1 forms whose meaning changed are refused with the new error code contract_changed. v1 commands whose meaning is unchanged and v1 blueprints are still read. The mixed form plan carries batch v2. Tool names, profiles and floors are unchanged; see docs/agent-command-v2.md.

get_document_node.description:
Get one bounded HWPX semantic node by canonical path. Shared catalog sha256:e1991f8cf51f9aa5f63f2d70139f98b7d418d16c3b80519cc7bae64eee1dc5f5.

HWPX agent document interface v1

document
  readable: title, author, sectionCount, paragraphCount, tableCount
  editable: -
  operations: add
section
  readable: index, partId, paragraphCount, pageWidthMm, pageHeightMm
  editable: -
  operations: add
paragraph
  readable: text, style, alignment, breakBefore, keepWithNext, lineSpacingPercent
  editable: text, style, alignment, breakBefore, keepWithNext, lineSpacingPercent
  operations: set, add, remove, move, copy
run
  readable: text, bold, italic, underline, fontName, fontSizePt, color
  editable: text, bold, italic, underline, fontName, fontSizePt, color
  operations: set, add, remove, copy
table
  readable: rowCount, columnCount, caption, widthMm, alignment
  editable: caption, alignment
  operations: set, add, remove, move, copy
row
  readable: index, cellCount, heightMm
  editable: heightMm
  operations: set, add, remove, move, copy
cell
  readable: text, row, column, rowSpan, columnSpan, verticalAlignment, backgroundColor
  editable: text, verticalAlignment, backgroundColor
  operations: set
form-field
  readable: name, value, fieldType, readOnly
  editable: value, readOnly
  operations: set
picture
  readable: name, altText, widthMm, heightMm, mediaType
  editable: altText
  operations: set, remove, move, copy
memo
  readable: text, author
  editable: text
  operations: set, remove, copy
footnote
  readable: text
  editable: text
  operations: set, remove, copy
endnote
  readable: text
  editable: text
  operations: set, remove, copy
shape
  readable: shapeType, name, altText, xMm, yMm, widthMm, heightMm
  editable: altText
  operations: set, remove, move, copy
unsupported

  editable: -
  operations: -

query_document_nodes.description: Query bounded semantic nodes with selector v1 and return canonical paths. Examples: paragraph[style="개요 1"]:contains("평가"), section > paragraph[type="normal"], table[id="123"] > row > cell. Shared catalog sha256:e1991f8cf51f9aa5f63f2d70139f98b7d418d16c3b80519cc7bae64eee1dc5f5.

apply_document_commands.description: Apply one heterogeneous atomic HWPX command batch using only the shared set/add/remove/move/copy union; all commands commit once or roll back. Shared catalog sha256:e1991f8cf51f9aa5f63f2d70139f98b7d418d16c3b80519cc7bae64eee1dc5f5.

dump_document_blueprint.description:
Dump one revision-bound HWPX document/subtree into a validated typed .hwpxbp; returns bounded manifest/fidelity evidence and never exposes raw XML. Shared blueprint catalog sha256:cd8fa6ef9240ed7f1452789feeea7732ddd36dfeed785ddb592b43fb60e6730d.

HWPX typed blueprint v1
  dump: revision-bound document/subtree -> deterministic .hwpxbp
  replay: source-bound|portable -> one atomic SavePipeline commit
  fidelity: exact, mapped; strict replay rejects degraded/unsupported
  limits: nodes=10000, assets=128, manifest=16777216 bytes
  raw XML, package parts, resident sessions, watch, and OfficeCLI are unavailable

replay_document_blueprint.description: Atomically replay one validated typed blueprint request with strict dependency mapping, caller-owned idempotency, one save, rollback, lossless/openSafety evidence, and no session state. Shared blueprint catalog sha256:cd8fa6ef9240ed7f1452789feeea7732ddd36dfeed785ddb592b43fb60e6730d.
